rationale: Battle-tested precedent: scripts/enrich-public-sources.ts (250 lines) executed Batch3 stage E 64/64 through the window API with identical fetch semantics (5-hop same-site, per-hop reserve+record, denial set, manual redirect, O_EXCL receipts) — zero ledger defects across the E/P1/P2/P3/M/B4 chain (seqs 1-895 contiguous, 0 missing). Option A clones a PROVEN ledger path; option B invents a new collector input surface.

Frozen-collector integrity: collect-jev-v3-sources.ts is the reviewed, citation-pinned capture instrument (rev2 APPROVED, G1 rev2 APPROVED). A --page-leads flag edits its discovery contract (seeds-carry-domains-only, every-URL-from-sitemap/feed) at exactly the point the ghost forensics depend on it. New flags risk subtle interactions (prequal/score/cap paths, dry-run semantics, seal-guard coverage) that a sidecar runner cannot introduce.

Proof parity is achievable WITHOUT shared code: the runner MUST import and call the collector TEST SEAMS directly — candidateFromPageHtml (collect-jev-v3-sources.ts:758) for page proof + isExcludedProductUrl (:201) / loadPublicExclusion (:463) for gates — not re-implement proof. This gives byte-identical proof semantics with zero collector edits. (Note: the enrichment extractor lib/jev-public-source-enrichment.ts is NOT proof-identical — wider selector allowlist, title-identity pinning, no bodyText≥80 gate — so the F1 runner must use the collector seams, not the enrichment lib.)
runnerContract: Exact curated URLs only (≤100 + ~20 hop headroom = 120 cap); page-lead list recorded {url, domain, brand, intendedClass-intent-only} BEFORE any fetch, immutable once fetching starts
Import collector seams: candidateFromPageHtml + isExcludedProductUrl + loadPublicExclusion (+ canonicalProductUrlKey); NO local proof re-implementation; NO enrichment-lib extractor

Window API: openSourceWindow with owner-decision SHA + authority binding; reserve+record EVERY hop kind=page (fetchOnce-identical: 5-hop same-site, denial set, manual redirect, 30s timeout); parseInvocationCap vs remaining; buildPublicSourceReceipt for public artifact
Pre-fetch exclusion gate costs zero; post-redirect-alias gate burns spent hops (rev2 F4 semantics); exclusion chains ALL v2 + Batch3 p1/p3/m2/m8 + Batch4 b4-7 + earlier G1 outputs
Pilot gate: 15-page-attempt pilot on first domain, 0 proof-pass ⇒ PAUSE + return to reviewer; per-domain pause-15/abandon-30, sub-cap 30, block-abandon on reviewer call
Seal guard: new-dirs-only, refuse overwrites (enrichment-runner wx-precedent); --dry-run planning-only with no spend; --source-window + --owner-decisions required
Runner script itself is Main-owned code: reviewed by reviewer BEFORE first fetch (read-only code review of the script, no spend), then frozen for the F1 run
optionBRejected: Collector --page-leads flag REJECTED: edits the frozen discovery contract, adds an untested input surface to the qualification-critical instrument, and buys nothing the sidecar cannot do via the exported test seams. If Main later proposes it, the bar is: full diff review + proof-parity tests against candidateFromPageHtml on a pinned fixture corpus + dry-run equivalence + a fresh reviewer approval — i.e., strictly more review than option A for strictly more risk.
captureAuthorization: DECISION ONLY. No fetching authorized. Next: Main writes the runner, reviewer code-reviews it (no-spend), then G1 execution authorization (reviewer + owner spend) may proceed per rev2 gates.
